translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Sinzhou's Tian Hongzheng, his brother Hongdao, and others came to court and the Ministry of Rites lavished gifts on them.

sentences.zh: 十一年，仁智子大雅襲，奉表謝恩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Hongzheng's son Daya inherited and presented a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Hongzheng's son Daya succeeded and memorialized thanks.

sentences.zh: 命思南收集各洞弩手二千人，備征調。

translations.literal: Sinan was ordered to collect two thousand crossbowmen from each cave for military levy.
translations.idiomatic: Sinan was ordered to raise two thousand crossbowmen from each cave for levy.

sentences.zh: 十四年，大雅入朝。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Daya entered court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Daya came to court.

sentences.zh: 十八年，思州諸洞蠻作亂，命信國公湯和等討之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the various caves of Sinzhou rebelled; the Duke of Xin'an, Tang He, and others were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Sinzhou's cave tribes rose; Duke of Xin'an Tang He and others were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 時寇出沒不常，聞師至，輒竄山谷間，退則復出剽掠。

translations.literal: The bandits appeared and vanished unpredictably; when troops arrived they would flee into mountain valleys, then emerge again to plunder when the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders struck unpredictably, vanishing into ravines when troops came and returning to loot when they left.

sentences.zh: 和等師抵其地，恐蠻人驚潰，乃令軍士於諸洞分屯立柵，與蠻人雜耕，使不復疑。

translations.literal: When He and the others reached the area, fearing the tribes would scatter in alarm, they had soldiers build stockades and farm alongside the tribes at each cave so suspicion would not return.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the tribes would bolt, He's men built stockades at each cave and farmed beside the natives until trust returned.

sentences.zh: 久之，以計擒其魁，余黨悉定，留兵鎮之。

translations.literal: After a long while they captured the ringleaders by stratagem; the rest were settled and troops were left to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In time they seized the leaders by ruse; the remainder were pacified and a garrison remained.

sentences.zh: 二十年移思南宣慰於鎮遠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Sinan pacification commission was moved to Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 the Sinan pacification seat was transferred to Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 大雅來謝恩。

translations.literal: Daya came to court to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Daya came to court with thanks.

sentences.zh: 思州宣慰弘正死，子琛襲。

translations.literal: Sinzhou Pacification Commissioner Hongzheng died and his son Chen inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Sinzhou Commissioner Hongzheng died; his son Chen succeeded.

sentences.zh: 三十年，大雅母楊氏來朝。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Daya's mother Lady Yang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 Daya's mother, Lady Yang, came to court.

sentences.zh: 永樂八年，大雅死，子宗鼎襲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongle Daya died and his son Zongding inherited.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 8 Daya died; his son Zongding succeeded.

sentences.zh: 初，宗鼎兇暴，與其副使黃禧構怨，奏訐累年。

translations.literal: At first Zongding was brutal; he and his vice commissioner Huang Xi nursed a grudge and denounced each other in memorials for years.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding was violent from the start; he and Vice Commissioner Huang Xi feuded and impeached each other for years.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以田氏世守其土，又先歸誠，曲與保全，改禧為辰州知府。

translations.literal: Because the Tian clan had long guarded the land and had first submitted, the court bent to preserve them and transferred Xi to be prefect of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Tian house had long held the soil and came over early, the court spared them and moved Xi to be Chenzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 未幾，思州宣慰田琛與宗鼎爭沙坑地有怨。

translations.literal: Before long Sinzhou Commissioner Tian Chen and Zongding quarreled over Shaken ground.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sinzhou Commissioner Tian Chen and Zongding clashed over Shaken territory.

sentences.zh: 禧遂與琛結，圖宗鼎，構兵。

translations.literal: Xi then joined Chen and plotted against Zongding, raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: Xi allied with Chen against Zongding and raised arms.

sentences.zh: 琛自稱天主，禧為大將，率兵攻思南。

translations.literal: Chen styled himself Heavenly Lord and Xi Great General, leading troops to attack Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen called himself Heavenly Lord and Xi Great General and marched on Sinan.

sentences.zh: 宗鼎挈家走，琛殺其弟，發其墳墓，並戮其母屍。

translations.literal: Zongding fled with his family; Chen killed his brother, opened his graves, and even hacked apart his mother's corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding fled with his household; Chen killed his brother, desecrated the tombs, and mutilated his mother's body.

sentences.zh: 宗鼎訴於朝，屢敕琛、禧赴闕自辨，皆拒命不至，潛使奸人入教坊司，伺隙為變。

translations.literal: Zongding appealed to court; the throne repeatedly ordered Chen and Xi to come for judgment, but both refused and secretly sent agents into the Court Entertainment Office to watch for chances of trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding sued at court; repeated orders summoned Chen and Xi, but they defied the summons and slipped agents into the Court Entertainment Office to await disorder.

sentences.zh: 事覺，遣行人蔣廷瓚召之，命鎮遠侯顧成以兵壓其境，執琛、禧械送京師，皆引服。

translations.literal: When the plot was discovered, envoys were sent to summon them; the Marquis of Zhenyuan, Gu Cheng, pressed the border with troops, seized Chen and Xi in fetters and sent them to the capital; both confessed.
translations.idiomatic: The plot exposed, envoys summoned them; Gu Cheng, Marquis of Zhenyuan, advanced with troops, seized Chen and Xi in irons, and sent them to the capital, where they confessed.

sentences.zh: 琛妻冉氏尤強悍，遣人招誘臺羅等寨苗普亮為亂，冀朝廷遣琛還招撫，以免死。

translations.literal: Chen's wife Lady Ran was especially fierce; she sent men to recruit the Miao chief Puliang of Tailuo and other stockades to rebel, hoping the court would send Chen back to pacify them and spare his life.
translations.idiomatic: Chen's wife Lady Ran was fierce; she incited Miao chief Puliang of Tailuo and others to rise, hoping Chen would be sent back to pacify them and escape death.

sentences.zh: 帝聞而錮之。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard, he had Chen imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and imprisoned Chen.

sentences.zh: 以宗鼎窮蹙來歸，得未減，令復職，還思南。

translations.literal: Because Zongding, driven to extremity, had come over, he was not reduced in punishment; he was ordered to resume office and return to Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding, having come in desperation, was spared reduction and ordered back to his post in Sinan.

sentences.zh: 而宗鼎必得報怨，以絕禍根。

translations.literal: But Zongding insisted on revenge to uproot the threat.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zongding demanded vengeance to cut off the root of trouble.

sentences.zh: 帝以宗鼎幸免禍，不自懲，乃更逞忿，亦留之。

translations.literal: The emperor, seeing Zongding spared yet unchastened, now raging again, detained him as well.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Zongding ungrateful and raging anew, the emperor detained him too.

sentences.zh: 宗鼎出誹言，因發祖母陰事，謂與禧奸，實造禍本。

translations.literal: Zongding uttered slander and raised his grandmother's secret affair, claiming adultery with Xi had truly caused the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding slandered and aired his grandmother's secret, claiming her affair with Xi had bred the calamity.

sentences.zh: 祖母亦發宗鼎縊殺親母瀆亂人倫事。

translations.literal: The grandmother in turn exposed that Zongding had strangled his own mother, violating human relations.
translations.idiomatic: The grandmother exposed Zongding's strangling of his mother, a breach of human duty.

sentences.zh: 帝命刑部正其罪，諭戶部尚書夏原吉曰：「琛、宗鼎分治思州、思南，皆為民害。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Punishments to fix their crimes and told Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji: "Chen and Zongding divided Sinzhou and Sinan, both harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had the Ministry of Punishments convict them and told Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji, "Chen and Zongding ruled Sinzhou and Sinan alike to the people's hurt.

sentences.zh: 琛不道，已正其辜。

translations.literal: Chen was lawless and his guilt has been punished.
translations.idiomatic: Chen broke the law and has paid for it.

sentences.zh: 宗鼎滅倫，罪不可宥。

translations.literal: Zongding destroyed human relations; his crime cannot be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zongding violated kinship; his crime admits no pardon.

sentences.zh: 其思州、思南三十九長官地，可更郡縣，設貴州布政使司總轄之。

translations.literal: Their thirty-nine native-official districts in Sinzhou and Sinan may be converted into prefectures and counties, and a Guizhou provincial administration commission established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Their thirty-nine native districts in Sinzhou and Sinan should become prefectures and counties, with a Guizhou provincial administration commission to govern them.

sentences.zh: 」命顧成剿臺羅諸寨。

translations.literal: " He ordered Gu Cheng to suppress the stockades of Tailuo and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered Gu Cheng to pacify Tailuo and the other stockades.

sentences.zh: 成斬苗賊普亮，思州乃平。

translations.literal: Cheng beheaded the Miao bandit Puliang and Sinzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng beheaded the Miao outlaw Puliang and Sinzhou was settled.

sentences.zh: 十二年遂分其地為八府四州，貴州為內地，自是始。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the territory was then divided into eight prefectures and four sub-prefectures; Guizhou became inner territory—this was the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the land was split into eight prefectures and four sub-prefectures; Guizhou entered the interior administration from that point.

sentences.zh: 兩宣慰廢，田氏遂亡。

translations.literal: The two pacification commissions were abolished and the Tian clan perished.
translations.idiomatic: Both pacification commissions were abolished and the Tian line ended.

sentences.zh: 正統初，蠻夷長官司奏土官衙門婚姻，皆從土俗，乞頒恩命。

translations.literal: In the early Zhengtong period the Manyi native-official district memorialized that marriages at native headmen's yamens followed tribal custom and begged imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhengtong the Manyi native office reported that yamen marriages followed tribal custom and asked for imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 帝以土司循襲舊俗，因親結婚者，既累經赦宥不論，繼今悉依朝廷禮法，違者罪之。

translations.literal: The emperor held that native offices followed old custom; those who had married kin despite repeated amnesties would not be counted, but hereafter all must follow court ritual—violators would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that native chiefs who had wed kin under old custom, already amnestied, would not be punished, but henceforth court rites applied on pain of crime.

sentences.zh: 景泰間，思南府奏府四面皆山，關隘五處，無城可守，乞發附近土軍修築。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai period Sinan prefecture memorialized that on all sides were mountains with five passes and no city to defend, and begged nearby native soldiers to build walls.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai Sinan reported mountains on every side, five passes, and no walled defense, and asked nearby native troops to build fortifications.

sentences.zh: 命巡撫王來經畫之。

translations.literal: The Grand Coordinator Wang Lai was ordered to plan it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Lai was ordered to lay out the works.

sentences.zh: 鎮遠，故為豎眼大田溪洞。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan was formerly the cave land of Shuyan Datian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan was once the Shuyan Datian cave country.

sentences.zh: 元初，置鎮遠沿邊溪洞招討使，後改為鎮遠府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuan a Zhenyuan frontier-cave pacification intendant was established; it was later changed to Zhenyuan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early Yuan saw a Zhenyuan frontier cave pacification intendant, later made Zhenyuan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年改為州，隸湖廣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu it was changed to a sub-prefecture under Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 it became a sub-prefecture under Huguang.

sentences.zh: 永樂十一年仍改府，屬貴州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongle it was again made a prefecture and placed under Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 11 it was restored as a prefecture under Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 領長官司二：曰遍橋，曰邛水十五洞。

translations.literal: It governed two native-official districts: Bianqiao and Qiongshui Fifteen Caves.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw two native districts: Bianqiao and the Qiongshui Fifteen Caves.

sentences.zh: 領縣二：曰鎮遠，即金容金達、楊溪公俄二長官司地；

translations.literal: It governed two counties: Zhenyuan, comprising the territories of the Jintong Jinda and Yangxi E'e native offices;
translations.idiomatic: It governed two counties: Zhenyuan, formed from the Jintong Jinda and Yangxi E'e native offices;

sentences.zh: 曰施秉，即施秉長官司地也。

translations.literal: and Shibing, comprising the Shibing native office.
translations.idiomatic: and Shibing, formed from the Shibing native office.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十年，土官趙士能來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Hongwu the native official Zhao Shineng came to court and presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 20 native official Zhao Shineng came to court with horses.

sentences.zh: 三十年，鎮遠鬼長菁等處苗民作亂，指揮萬繼、百戶吳彬戰死。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year the Miao of Gui-chang Jing and other places in Zhenyuan rebelled; Commander Wan Ji and Centurion Wu Bin died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 Zhenyuan Miao at Gui-chang Jing and elsewhere rose; Commander Wan Ji and Centurion Wu Bin fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 都指揮許能率兵會偏橋衛軍擊敗之，眾散走。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Xu Neng led troops with the Pianqiao Guard army to defeat them; the masses scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Xu Neng with Pianqiao Guard troops routed them and the crowds fled.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，鎮遠長官何惠言：「每歲修治清浪、焦溪、鎮遠三橋，工費浩大。

translations.literal: In the early Yongle period Zhenyuan native official He Hui said: "Each year repairing the three bridges at Qinglang, Jiaoxi, and Zhenyuan costs a great sum.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongle Zhenyuan native official He Hui said, "Annual repairs to the Qinglang, Jiaoxi, and Zhenyuan bridges cost heavily.

sentences.zh: 所部臨溪部民，皆佯、儣、亻苗、佬，力不勝役，乞令軍民參助。

translations.literal: The river-bank stockade people under his command are all Yang, Liao, Miao, and Lao; their strength cannot bear corvée; he begged that troops and civilians be ordered to assist together.
translations.idiomatic: My riverine subjects—Yang, Liao, Miao, and Lao peoples—cannot bear the levy alone; please order troops and settlers to share the work.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved.

sentences.zh: 宣德初，鎮遠邛水奧洞蠻苗章奴劫掠清浪道中，為思州都坪峨異溪長官司所獲。

translations.literal: In the early Xuande period the Ao-cave Miao bandit Zhang Nu of Zhenyuan's Qiongshui plundered the Qinglang road and was captured by the Duping Eyi Creek native office of Sinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Xuande the Ao-cave Miao outlaw Zhang Nu of Zhenyuan's Qiongshui raided the Qinglang route and was taken by Sinzhou's Duping Eyi Creek native office.

sentences.zh: 其父苗銀總劫取之，聚兵欲攻思州。

translations.literal: His father the Miao Yin-zong plundered and seized it, gathered troops and intended to attack Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yin-zong, a Miao leader, had seized the territory by looting and then raised forces to attack Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 因令赤溪洞長官楊通諒往撫，銀總伏兵殺諒，又掠埂洞。

translations.literal: Accordingly he ordered the Chixi-dong native official Yang Tong-liang to go and pacify them; Yin-zong set an ambush and killed Liang, and again raided Geng-dong.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yang Tong-liang, headman of Chixi Cave, to negotiate, but Yin-zong ambushed and killed him and raided Geng Cave as well.

sentences.zh: 命總兵官蕭授調辰、沅諸衛兵萬四千人剿之，會於清浪衛，指揮張名討銀總，克奧洞，盡殺其黨，銀總遁。

translations.literal: He ordered the supreme commander Xiao Shou to mobilize fourteen thousand troops from the Chen and Yuan guards to suppress them; they assembled at Qinglang Guard; the commander Zhang Ming attacked Yin-zong, captured Ao-dong, killed all his followers entirely, and Yin-zong fled.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Xiao Shou was ordered to raise 14,000 men from the Chen and Yuan guards; they rendezvoused at Qinglang, where Commander Zhang Ming took Ao Cave, wiped out Yin-zong's band, and drove him to flight.

sentences.zh: 正統三年革鎮遠州，以鎮遠、施秉二長官司隸鎮遠府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong Zhenyuan prefecture was abolished; the two native-official offices of Zhenyuan and Shibing were placed under Zhenyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1438 Zhenyuan prefecture was abolished, and the Zhenyuan and Shibing native chieftaincies were subordinated to the Zhenyuan prefectural government.

sentences.zh: 十二年，巡按御史虞禎奏：「貴州蠻賊出沒，撫之不從，捕之不得，若非設策，難以控制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the touring censor Yu Zhen memorialized: "Guizhou barbarian bandits appear and vanish; when pacified they do not obey, when pursued they cannot be caught; unless measures are devised, control will be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In 1447 Touring Censor Yu Zhen reported that Guizhou tribal raiders struck unpredictably, ignored pacification, and eluded capture, and that only a deliberate policy could keep them in check.

sentences.zh: 臣觀清水江等處，峭壁層崖，僅通一徑出入，彼得恃險為惡。

translations.literal: Your subject observes that at places such as the Qingshui River there are sheer cliffs and tiered crags, with only a single path for entry and exit; they thereby rely on the terrain to do evil.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingshui River country, he noted, is a maze of cliffs with but one narrow pass, terrain that outlaws could readily exploit.

sentences.zh: 若將江外山口盡行閉塞，江內山口並津渡俱設關堡，屯兵守禦，又擇寨長有才幹者為辦事官，庶毋疏虞。

translations.literal: If all passes outside the river are entirely blocked, and passes inside the river together with ferry crossings are all provided with frontier forts and garrison troops to defend them, and furthermore capable stockade headmen are selected as administrative officers, perhaps negligence may be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed sealing the outer approaches, fortifying inner passes and ferries with garrisons, and appointing able stockade chiefs as local agents, measures that might close gaps in control.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his plan.

sentences.zh: 十四年命振偏橋衛，以被苗寇殺掠，不能自存，有司以請，從之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to restore Pianqiao Guard, because having been killed and plundered by Miao bandits it could not sustain itself; the responsible officials requested this and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In 1449 Pianqiao Guard, ravaged by Miao raids to the point of collapse, was ordered rebuilt at the officials' request.

sentences.zh: 天順七年，鎮守湖廣太監郭閔奏：「貴州洪江賊苗蟲蝦等糾合二千余人，偽稱王侯，攻劫鎮遠屯寨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianshun the Huguang garrison eunuch Guo Min memorialized: "The Hongjiang bandit Miao Chong-xia and others gathered more than two thousand men, falsely styled themselves kings and marquises, and attacked and plundered Zhenyuan garrison stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In 1463 Garrison Eunuch Guo Min of Huguang reported that Chong-xia of Hongjiang had raised over 2,000 Miao, proclaimed themselves kings and marquises, and raided Zhenyuan military colonies.

sentences.zh: 撫諭不服，請合兵進討。

translations.literal: When pacified they did not submit; he requested combined forces to advance and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: They refused to accept pacification, and he asked for a joint punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 」命總兵官李震、李安等分道入，賊退守平坤寨，官兵追至清水江，獲蟲蝦，並斬賊首飛天侯、苗老底、額頭等六百四十余人，並復黎平之赤溪湳洞，賊平。

translations.literal: He ordered the supreme commanders Li Zhen and Li An and others to enter by separate routes; the bandits retreated to defend Pingkun stockade; government troops pursued to the Qingshui River, captured Chong-xia, and beheaded the bandit leaders Flying-Heaven Marquis, Miao Lao-di, E-tou, and others, more than six hundred forty persons in all, and also recovered Chixi-nan-dong of Liping; the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme commanders Li Zhen and Li An were sent in by separate columns; the rebels fell back on Pingkun stockade but were pursued to the Qingshui River, where Chong-xia was taken and over 640 ringleaders, including the self-styled Flying-Heaven Marquis, were beheaded; Chixi-nan-dong in Liping was recovered and the rising was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年改鎮遠金容金達長官司為鎮遠州，設流官。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Hongzhi the Zhenyuan Jin-rong Jin-da native-official office was changed to Zhenyuan prefecture and a regular official was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1497 the Zhenyuan Jin-rong Jin-da native chieftaincy was converted into a regular prefecture with an appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 時土官碖父子罪死，土人思得流官，守臣以聞，報可。

translations.literal: At that time the native official Qi and his son had been condemned to death; the local people wished to have a regular official; the defending officials reported this and approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi father and son, native rulers, had been executed for crimes, and the populace petitioned for civil administration; the frontier authorities reported this and the change was approved.

sentences.zh: 萬歷末，邛水長官司楊光春貪暴，土目彭必信濟之箕斂。

translations.literal: At the end of the Wanli reign the Qiongshui native-official Yang Guang-chun was greedy and violent, and the native clerk Peng Bi-xin assisted him in extortion.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Wanli period Yang Guang-chun, Qiongshui native official, ruled with greed and violence while his clerk Peng Bi-xin helped squeeze the people.

sentences.zh: 苗不堪，將上訴改設流官，光春與必信遂謀反，言官兵欲剿諸苗，當斂金贖，得金五百余。

translations.literal: The Miao could not bear it and were about to appeal to have a regular official installed; Guang-chun and Bi-xin thereupon plotted rebellion, saying government troops intended to suppress the various Miao and that they should collect gold as ransom, obtaining more than five hundred taels.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao, unable to endure the exactions, prepared to petition for civil rule; Guang-chun and Bi-xin then rebelled, falsely warning that troops would exterminate the tribes unless ransoms were paid, and collected over 500 taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 都御史何起鳴诇知之，捕光春下獄，瘐死。

translations.literal: The censor-in-chief He Qi-ming learned of it through investigation, arrested Guang-chun and imprisoned him, and he died in prison from illness.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator He Qi-ming uncovered the plot, arrested Guang-chun, and imprisoned him until he died of illness in jail.

sentences.zh: 於是每四戶擇壯兵一人，立四哨，不為兵者佐糗糧魚鹽，簡土吏何文奎等掌之。

translations.literal: Thereupon from every four households one able-bodied man was chosen to form four watches; those not serving as soldiers supplied grain, fish, and salt; the native clerk He Wen-kui and others were appointed to manage this.
translations.idiomatic: A militia system was then imposed: one able man from every four households in four watches, with non-combatants supplying provisions, under native clerks such as He Wen-kui.

sentences.zh: 必信復醵諸苗金，訴於朝，言巴也、梁止諸寨為亂，指揮使陶效忠不問，反索土官楊光春金而殺之。

translations.literal: Bi-xin again levied gold from the various Miao and appealed to the court, saying the stockades Baye and Liangzhi and others were in rebellion and that the commander Tao Xiao-zhong had ignored it but instead demanded gold from the native official Yang Guang-chun and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Bi-xin levied more gold from the tribes and memorialized the throne, claiming that Baye, Liangzhi, and other stockades had risen while Commander Tao Xiao-zhong had ignored the revolt and instead extorted gold from Yang Guang-chun and killed him.

sentences.zh: 改舊例用新法，不便。

translations.literal: The old regulations were changed to the new method, which was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: The new arrangements replaced the old rules to the people's detriment.

sentences.zh: 書上，意自得，歸謁知府王一麟。

translations.literal: When the memorial was sent up he was pleased with himself and returned to call on the prefect Wang Yi-lin.
translations.idiomatic: Confident his petition would succeed, he returned to present himself to Prefect Wang Yi-lin.

sentences.zh: 一麟縛之下獄，檄諸苗，言：「若等十五洞所苦者，以兵餉月米三斗過甚耳。

translations.literal: Yi-lin bound him and put him in prison, and issued a proclamation to the various Miao, saying: "What you of the fifteen caves suffer from is only that the monthly military grain ration of three dou per household is excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi-lin arrested and jailed him, then addressed the fifteen cave communities: their grievance, he said, was merely the excessive three-dou monthly militia ration.

sentences.zh: 然歲給白蟲鋪米，每洞月八斗，他於平溪驛剩余征銀兩，皆可足餉。

translations.literal: Yet each year white-grain and insect-grain rations are issued, eight dou per cave per month, and besides this the surplus silver collected at the Pingxi courier station can fully cover the rations.
translations.idiomatic: Annual grain allowances of eight dou per cave per month, together with surplus silver from the Pingxi courier station, could fully cover the rations, he explained.

sentences.zh: 我為若通之，毋為必信所誣。

translations.literal: I will secure this for you; do not be deceived by Bi-xin.
translations.idiomatic: He promised to secure relief for them and warned them not to be misled by Bi-xin.

sentences.zh: 」苗皆悅服，乃坐必信罪。

translations.literal: The Miao were all pleased and submitted; Bi-xin was then punished.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes accepted the settlement with satisfaction, and Bi-xin was punished.

sentences.zh: 時有土舍楊載清者應襲推官，嘗中貴州鄉試，命於本衛加俸級優異之。

translations.literal: At that time there was a native cadet Yang Zai-qing who was due to inherit the post of vice-prefect; he had once passed the Guizhou provincial examination; he was ordered to receive an additional salary grade at his guard, an exceptional favor.
translations.idiomatic: About this time Yang Zai-qing, a native cadet eligible to inherit a vice-prefect's post and a former Guizhou provincial examination graduate, was granted an extra stipend grade at his guard as a special honor.

sentences.zh: 天啟五年，巡撫傅宗龍奏：「苗寇披猖，地方受害，乞敕偏沅撫臣移鎮偏橋，勿復回沅，凡思、石、偏、鎮等處俾練兵萬余人，平時以之剿苗，大征即統為督臣後勁，庶苗患寧而西賊之氣亦漸奪矣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianqi the grand coordinator Fu Zong-long memorialized: "Miao bandits run rampant and the region suffers; I beg an order to the Pian-Yuan grand coordinator to move his headquarters to Pianqiao and not return to Yuan, and that at Si, Shi, Pian, Zhen, and other places more than ten thousand troops be trained so that in normal times they may suppress the Miao and in a major campaign serve as the grand coordinator's reserve, so that the Miao trouble may be settled and the western rebels' momentum may gradually be checked.
translations.idiomatic: In 1625 Grand Coordinator Fu Zong-long urged that the Pian-Yuan governor shift permanently to Pianqiao, maintain over 10,000 trained troops across Si, Shi, Pian, Zhen, and neighboring districts for routine pacification and as a strategic reserve in major campaigns, thereby curbing Miao unrest and weakening western rebel power.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 銅仁，元為銅人大小江等處軍民長官司。

translations.literal: Tongren: under the Yuan it was the Tongren Greater and Lesser River military-civilian native-official office.
translations.idiomatic: Tongren had been, under the Yuan, the Tongren Greater and Lesser River military-civilian native chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，改為銅仁長官司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu it was changed to the Tongren native-official office.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Hongwu reign it became the Tongren native chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 永樂十一年置銅仁府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongle Tongren Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Tongren Prefecture was established in 1413.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十六年始改銅仁長官司為縣治。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Wanli the Tongren native-official office was first changed to a county seat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1598 the Tongren native chieftaincy was converted into a county administration.

sentences.zh: 領長官司五：曰省溪，曰提溪，曰大萬山，曰烏羅，曰平頭著可。

translations.literal: It governed five native-official offices: namely Shengxi, Tixi, Dawanshan, Wuluo, and Pingtou Zhu-ke.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw five native chieftaincies: Shengxi, Tixi, Dawanshan, Wuluo, and Pingtou Zhu-ke.

sentences.zh: 烏羅者，本永樂時分置貴州八府之一也，所屬有朗溪長官司、答意長官司、治古長官司，而平頭著可長官司亦隸焉。

translations.literal: Wuluo was originally one of the eight prefectures established in Guizhou in the Yongle period; subordinate to it were the Langxi, Dayi, and Zhigu native-official offices, and the Pingtou Zhu-ke native-official office was also subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: Wuluo, one of the eight Guizhou prefectures created under Yongle, had subordinate chieftaincies at Langxi, Dayi, and Zhigu, as well as Pingtou Zhu-ke.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，烏羅知府嚴律己言：「所屬治古、答意二長官石各野等聚眾出沒銅仁、平頭、甕橋諸處，誘脅蠻賊石雞娘並筸子坪長官吳畢郎等共為亂，招撫不從。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande the Wuluo prefect Yan Lv-yi memorialized: "The subordinate Zhigu and Dayi native officials Shi Ge-ye and others have gathered crowds to appear and vanish in Tongren, Pingtou, Wengqiao, and other places, enticing and coercing the barbarian bandit Shi Ji-niang together with the Gaozi-ping native official Wu Bi-lang and others to join in rebellion; pacification was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1430 Wuluo Prefect Yan Lv-yi reported that his subordinates Ge-ye of Zhigu and other headmen of Zhigu and Dayi were raiding Tongren, Pingtou, and Wengqiao, inciting the bandit Shi Ji-niang and Wu Bi-lang of Gaozi-ping to revolt despite offers of pacification.

sentences.zh: 緣其地與鎮溪、酉陽諸蠻接境，恐相煽為亂。

translations.literal: Because their territory borders the various barbarians of Zhenxi and Youyang, I fear they will incite one another to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Their territory bordered Zhenxi and Youyang tribes, he warned, raising the risk of a wider uprising.

sentences.zh: 請調官土軍分據要地，絕其糧道，且捕且撫。

translations.literal: I request that government and native troops be mobilized to hold key points, cut off their grain routes, and both suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for regular and native troops to seize key positions, cut supply lines, and combine suppression with negotiation.

sentences.zh: 事平之後，宜置衛所巡司以守之。

translations.literal: After the affair is settled, guards, posts, and inspection offices should be established to defend the area.
translations.idiomatic: After pacification he urged establishing guards, posts, and patrol offices for long-term defense.

sentences.zh: 」事聞，命總兵官蕭授及鎮巡諸司議。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the supreme commander Xiao Shou and the frontier defense officials were ordered to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: On receipt of the memorial, Supreme Commander Xiao Shou and the frontier authorities were ordered to plan a response.

sentences.zh: 於是授築二十四堡，環其地守之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shou built twenty-four forts encircling the territory to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shou then ringed the region with twenty-four fortified posts.

sentences.zh: 兵力分，卒難扞禦。

translations.literal: Military strength was divided, and in the end defense was difficult.
translations.idiomatic: But the scattered garrisons proved too weak to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 賊四出劫掠，殺清浪衛鎮撫葉受，勢益獗。

translations.literal: The bandits sallied forth on all sides to plunder, killed the Qinglang Guard garrison commander Ye Shou, and their power grew more ferocious.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels raided in all directions, killed Qinglang Guard Commander Ye Shou, and grew bolder.

sentences.zh: 七年，巡按御史以聞，且言生苗之地不過三百余裏，乞別遣良將督諸軍殄滅。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the touring censor reported this and also said that the territory of the raw Miao was no more than three hundred-odd li; he begged that another able general be dispatched to supervise the various armies and exterminate them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1452 the touring censor reported the crisis and noted that the raw Miao country covered barely 300 li, urging dispatch of a capable general to annihilate them.

sentences.zh: 授言：「殘苗吳不爾等遁入筸子坪，結生苗龍不登等攻劫湖廣五寨及白崖諸寨，為患滋甚。

translations.literal: Shou said: "The remnant Miao Wu Bu-er and others have fled into Gaozi-ping, joined with the raw Miao Long Bu-deng and others to attack and plunder the five stockades of Huguang and the various stockades of Baiya; the harm grows more severe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shou replied that Wu Bu-er and other fugitives had taken refuge in Gaozi-ping, allied with raw Miao under Long Bu-deng, and were raiding Huguang's five stockades and Baiya, with the threat spreading.

sentences.zh: 宜令川、湖、貴州接境諸官軍、土兵分路並力攻剿，庶除邊患。

translations.literal: Government and native troops from Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou along the border should be ordered to advance by separate routes with combined force to suppress them, so that the frontier trouble may be removed.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed a coordinated strike by border troops of Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou advancing on several routes.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 既降敕諭授，言：「暴師久，恐蹉跌為蠻羞，或撫或剿，朕觀成功，不從中制。

translations.literal: An imperial edict was then issued instructing Shou, saying: "The army has been deployed long; I fear a stumble would shame us before the barbarians; whether to pacify or suppress, I await success and will not interfere from the center.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then instructed Xiao Shou that prolonged campaigning risked disgrace if mishandled, and that he might choose pacification or suppression as he saw fit without central micromanagement.

sentences.zh: 八年，授奏言：「臣受命統率諸軍進攻賊巢，破新郎等寨，前後生擒賊首吳不跳等二百一十二人，斬吳不爾、王老虎、龍安軸等五百九十余級，皆梟以徇，余黨悉平。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Shou memorialized, saying: "Your subject received orders to command the various armies in attacking the bandit lairs, broke the stockades of Xin-lang and others, and before and after captured the bandit leaders Wu Bu-tiao and others, two hundred twelve persons; beheaded Wu Bu-er, Wang Lao-hu, Long An-zhou, and others, more than five hundred ninety heads; all were displayed as a warning; the remaining factions were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In 1453 Xiao Shou reported that he had stormed rebel strongholds including Xin-lang, captured 212 leaders such as Wu Bu-tiao, and beheaded over 590 including Wu Bu-er, Wang Lao-hu, and Long An-zhou, displaying the heads and pacifying the rest.

sentences.zh: 還所掠軍民男婦九十八口，悉給所親。

translations.literal: He returned ninety-eight male and female civilians of the army and people who had been seized, all given to their kin.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-eight civilians taken captive were restored to their families.

sentences.zh: 獲賊婦女幼弱一千六百余口，以給從征將士。

translations.literal: More than sixteen hundred captive women, children, and the weak were given to the officers and soldiers who had joined the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Over 1,600 women and children taken in the campaign were distributed among the troops.

sentences.zh: 」並械吳不跳等獻京師。

translations.literal: Wu Bu-tiao and others were also sent in fetters to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bu-tiao and other captives were sent to the capital in chains.

sentences.zh: 帝顧謂侍臣曰：「蠻苗好亂，自取滅亡，然於朕心，不能無惻然也。

translations.literal: The emperor turned to the attending officials and said: "The barbarian Miao love disorder and bring destruction on themselves; yet in my heart I cannot be without compassion for them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his attendants that the Miao brought ruin on themselves through rebellion, yet he could not view their fate without pity.

sentences.zh: 」授威服南荒，前後凡二十余年。

translations.literal: Shou's prestige subdued the southern wilds; altogether it lasted more than twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shou's authority held the southern frontier for more than twenty years.

sentences.zh: 正統三年革烏羅府，所屬治古、答意二長官司，亂後殘民無幾，亦並革之，以烏羅、平頭著可隸銅仁，以朗溪隸思南，從巡按御史請也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong the Wuluo prefecture was abolished; its subordinate Zhigu and Dayi native-official offices, after the disorders with few surviving people, were also abolished together; Wuluo and Pingtou Zhu-ke were placed under Tongren, and Langxi under Sinan, following the touring censor's request.
translations.idiomatic: In 1438 Wuluo prefecture was abolished; its depopulated subordinates Zhigu and Dayi were also eliminated; Wuluo and Pingtou Zhu-ke went to Tongren and Langxi to Sinan, as the touring censor had urged.

sentences.zh: 景泰七年，平頭著可長官司奏其地多為蠻賊侵害，乞立土城固守，從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jingtai the Pingtou Zhu-ke native-official office memorialized that its territory was largely harmed by barbarian bandits and begged to build an earthen walled town for defense; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1456 Pingtou Zhu-ke reported heavy raids and was permitted to build an earthen walled town for defense.

sentences.zh: 成化十一年，總兵官李震奏：「烏羅苗人石全州，妄稱元末明氏子孫，僭稱明王，糾眾於執銀等處作亂，鄰洞多應之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chenghua the supreme commander Li Zhen memorialized: "The Wuluo Miao Shi Quan-zhou falsely claimed to be a descendant of the Ming house of the late Yuan, styled himself King Ming, and gathered crowds to rebel at Zhi-yin and other places; neighboring caves largely responded.
translations.idiomatic: In 1475 Supreme Commander Li Zhen reported that Shi Quan-zhou of Wuluo Miao had falsely claimed descent from the Yuan-era Ming house, proclaimed himself King Ming, and raised rebels at Zhi-yin with wide support from neighboring caves.

sentences.zh: 因調官軍往剿，石全州已就擒，而諸苗攻劫未已。

translations.literal: Because government troops were mobilized to suppress them, Shi Quan-zhou was already captured, yet the various Miao attacks and plundering did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Although Quan-zhou was captured when troops were sent against him, raids continued across the region.

sentences.zh: 」命鎮巡官設策撫捕，未幾平。

translations.literal: The frontier defense officials were ordered to devise measures to pacify and capture them; before long it was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials were ordered to pacify and suppress the remainder, and order was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十二年，平頭苗賊龍桑科作亂，流劫湖廣桂陽間，甚獗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiajing the Pingtou Miao bandit Long Sang-ke rebelled and ranged through Guilin in Huguang, very fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: In 1543 the Pingtou Miao rebel Long Sang-ke raided fiercely through Huguang's Guilin region.

sentences.zh: 帝以諸苗再叛，責激亂者，而起都御史萬鏜往討之。

translations.literal: Because the various Miao rebelled again, the emperor blamed those who had provoked disorder and dispatched the censor-in-chief Wan Rong to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, blaming officials for provoking renewed Miao revolts, sent Grand Coordinator Wan Rong to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 明年，鏜奏叛苗以次殄滅，惟龍母叟雖降，然其罪大，宜置重典。

translations.literal: The next year Rong memorialized that the rebel Miao were successively exterminated; only Long Mu-sou, though he had surrendered, yet his crime was grave and he should receive a heavy penalty.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Wan Rong reported that the rebels had been largely destroyed, but that Long Mu-sou, though surrendered, deserved severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 命安置遼東。

translations.literal: He was ordered settled in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Mu-sou was banished to Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 未幾，龍子賢復叛。

translations.literal: Before long Long Zi-xian rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward his son Long Zi-xian rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，湖貴巡按御史奏官軍討賊不力，降旨切責。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Huguang-Guizhou touring censor memorialized that government troops had been ineffective in suppressing the bandits; an edict sharply rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1547 the Huguang-Guizhou touring censor reported ineffective campaigning, and the court issued a sharp rebuke.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，總兵官石邦憲剿之，擒首惡龍老羅等，遂平。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the supreme commander Shi Bang-xian suppressed them, captured the chief villain Long Lao-luo and others, and then it was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In 1560 Supreme Commander Shi Bang-xian crushed the rising, capturing ringleader Long Lao-luo and others, and peace was restored.

sentences.zh: 黎平，元潭溪地也。

translations.literal: Liping: it was Yuan Tanxi territory.
translations.idiomatic: Liping had been Tanxi territory under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，仍各長官司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu the various native-official offices remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Hongwu period the native chieftaincies continued as before.

sentences.zh: 永樂十一年改置黎平、新化二府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongle the two prefectures of Liping and Xinhua were established.
translations.idiomatic: Liping and Xinhua prefectures were established in 1413.

sentences.zh: 宣德十年並新化入黎平。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xuande Xinhua was merged into Liping.
translations.idiomatic: In 1435 Xinhua was annexed to Liping.

sentences.zh: 領長官司十三：曰潭溪，曰八舟，曰洪舟泊裏，曰曹滴洞，曰古州，曰西山陽洞，曰湖耳，曰亮寨，曰歐陽，曰新化，曰中林驗洞，曰赤溪湳洞，曰龍裏。

translations.literal: It governed thirteen native-official offices: namely Tanxi, Bazhou, Hongzhou-boli, Caodi-dong, Guzhou, Xishan-yang-dong, Hu'er, Liangzhai, Ouyang, Xinhua, Zhonglin-yan-dong, Chixi-nan-dong, and Longli.
translations.idiomatic: It administered thirteen native chieftaincies: Tanxi, Bazhou, Hongzhou-boli, Caodi-dong, Guzhou, Xishan-yang-dong, Hu'er, Liangzhai, Ouyang, Xinhua, Zhonglin-yan-dong, Chixi-nan-dong, and Longli.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武三年，辰州衛指揮劉宣武率兵招降湖耳、潭溪、新化、萬平江、歐陽諸洞，於是諸洞長官皆來朝，納元所授印敕。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the third year of Hongwu, the Chenzhou Guard commander Liu Xuanwu led troops to induce the surrender of the caves of Hu'er, Tanxi, Xinhua, Wanping-jiang, and Ouyang; thereupon the various cave native officials all came to court and surrendered the seals and patents they had received from the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1370 Chenzhou Guard Commander Liu Xuanwu had led troops to win over Hu'er, Tanxi, Xinhua, Wanping-jiang, and Ouyang, whose headmen then presented themselves at court and surrendered their Yuan seals and patents.

sentences.zh: 帝命皆仍其原官，以轄洞民，隸辰州衛。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that all should retain their former offices to govern the cave peoples, subordinate to Chenzhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor confirmed them in their former posts to rule their cave communities under Chenzhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 既改龍裏長官司為龍裏衛，又增立五開衛以鎮之，隸思州。

translations.literal: After Longli native-official office was changed to Longli Guard, Wukai Guard was also added to garrison it, subordinate to Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: Longli chieftaincy was later converted to Longli Guard, and Wukai Guard was added as a garrison under Sinan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，清水江蠻金牌黃作亂，都司發兵捕之，金牌黃遁去。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Qingshui River barbarian Jin-pai-huang rebelled; the provincial commission dispatched troops to capture him, and Jin-pai-huang fled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1396 the Qingshui River tribesman Jin-pai-huang rebelled; provincial troops were sent against him, but he escaped.

sentences.zh: 捕獲其黨五百余人，械至京，以其脅從，宥死，戍遠衛。

translations.literal: More than five hundred of his followers were captured, sent to the capital in fetters; because they had been coerced, death was pardoned and they were exiled to guard the distant frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Over 500 followers were captured and sent to the capital; as coerced participants they were spared execution and exiled to distant garrisons.

sentences.zh: 既有言金牌黃匿宣慰家者，詔勿問。

translations.literal: When it was said that Jin-pai-huang was hidden in a pacification commissioner's household, an edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Reports that Jin-pai-huang was sheltered by a native pacification commissioner were met with an order not to pursue the matter.

sentences.zh: 三十年，古州洞蠻林寬者，自號小師，聚眾作亂，攻龍裏。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year the Guzhou cave barbarian Lin Kuan styled himself Junior Master, gathered crowds to rebel, and attacked Longli.
translations.idiomatic: In 1397 Lin Kuan of Guzhou Cave styled himself Junior Master, raised a rebel force, and attacked Longli.

sentences.zh: 千戶吳得、鎮撫井孚力戰死之。

translations.literal: The company commander Wu De and the garrison commander Jing Fu fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: Company Commander Wu De and Garrison Commander Jing Fu were killed in fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 寬遂犯新化，突至平茶，千戶紀達率壯士擊之。

translations.literal: Kuan then invaded Xinhua and suddenly reached Pingcha; the company commander Ji Da led stalwarts to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan then struck Xinhua and advanced suddenly to Pingcha, where Company Commander Ji Da led a counterattack.

sentences.zh: 達突陣殺數人，以槍橫挑一人擲之，流矢中臂，達拔矢復戰。

translations.literal: Da charged the line and killed several men, used his spear to lift one man horizontally and throw him; a stray arrow struck his arm; Da pulled out the arrow and fought again.
translations.idiomatic: Da broke the enemy line, killed several men, and hurled one soldier aside on his spear; struck in the arm by a stray arrow, he pulled it out and continued fighting.

sentences.zh: 賊驚曰：「是平茶紀蒙邪？

translations.literal: The bandits exclaimed in alarm: "Is this not Pingcha Ji Meng?"
translations.idiomatic: The rebels cried in alarm: "Can this be Ji Meng of Pingcha?"

sentences.zh: 」遁去。

translations.literal: They fled.
translations.idiomatic: They fled.

sentences.zh: 蠻稱官為蒙雲。

translations.literal: The barbarians called officials Meng-yun.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes called officials "Meng."

sentences.zh: 已，復熾，命湖廣都指揮使齊讓為平羌將軍，統兵五萬征之。

translations.literal: Before long they flared up again; the Huguang provincial commander Qi Rang was appointed Pacification General for the Qiang and commanded fifty thousand troops to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: The rising soon revived; Huguang Provincial Commander Qi Rang was appointed Pacification General and given 50,000 troops for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 既以讓逗遛，命楊文代之。

translations.literal: Because Rang delayed, Yang Wen was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Rang stalled, Yang Wen was sent to replace him.

sentences.zh: 又命楚王楨、湘王柏各率護衛兵進討，城銅鼓衛。

translations.literal: The Prince of Chu Zhu Zhen and the Prince of Xiang Zhu Bai were also each ordered to lead guard troops in the advance to suppress them, and Tonggu Guard was walled.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Zhu Zhen of Chu and Zhu Bai of Xiang were also ordered to advance with guard troops, and Tonggu Guard was fortified.

sentences.zh: 未幾，讓擒寬等，械入京，誅之。

translations.literal: Before long Rang captured Kuan and others, sent them to the capital in fetters, and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Rang soon captured Kuan and his fellows, sent them to the capital in chains, and they were executed.

sentences.zh: 三十一年復平其余黨，並俘獲三十岡等處洞蠻二千九百人以歸，遂班師。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the remaining factions were again pacified, and cave barbarians of Sangang and other places, two thousand nine hundred persons, were captured and brought back; the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In 1398 remaining rebels were subdued, 2,900 tribesmen from Sangang and other caves were taken, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 永樂五年，寨長韋萬木來朝，自陳所統四十七寨，乞設官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongle the stockade head Wei Wan-mu came to court and stated that the forty-seven stockades he ruled begged for officials to be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1407 Stockade Head Wei Wan-mu presented himself at court and asked that officials be appointed over his forty-seven stockades.

sentences.zh: 因設西山陽洞長官司，以萬木為屯長。

translations.literal: Accordingly the Xishan-yang-dong native-official office was established, with Wan-mu as garrison head.
translations.idiomatic: The Xishan-yang-dong native chieftaincy was then established with Wan-mu as garrison head.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年改永從蠻夷長官司為永從縣，置流官，以土官李瑛絕故也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuande the Yongcong barbarian native-official office was changed to Yongcong County and a regular official was appointed, because the native official Li Ying's line had died out.
translations.idiomatic: In 1431 Yongcong barbarian chieftaincy became Yongcong County with a civil magistrate after the Li Ying native line died out.

sentences.zh: 又割思州新溪等十一寨隸黎平赤溪湳洞長官司。

translations.literal: Eleven stockades of Sinan's Xinxi and others were also cut off and placed under Liping's Chixi-nan-dong native-official office.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Sinan stockades including Xinxi were also transferred to Liping's Chixi-nan-dong chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，計砂苗賊苗金蟲等糾合洪江生苗，偽立統千侯、統萬侯名號，劫掠四出，命都督蕭授調兵剿之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhengtong the Jisha Miao bandits Miao Jin-chong and others gathered Hongjiang raw Miao, falsely established the titles Commander of Thousands and Commander of Tens of Thousands, and ranged on all sides to plunder; the commissioner Xiao Shou was ordered to mobilize troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1439 Jisha Miao under Jin-chong allied with Hongjiang raw Miao, proclaimed themselves commanders of thousands and tens of thousands, and raided widely; Commissioner Xiao Shou was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 賊首苗總牌等為都督吳亮所戮，洪江生苗遂詣軍門降。

translations.literal: The bandit leaders Miao Zong-pai and others were slain by the commissioner Wu Liang, and the Hongjiang raw Miao then came to the army gate to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ringleader Zong-pai and others were killed by Commissioner Wu Liang, and the Hongjiang raw Miao surrendered at headquarters.

sentences.zh: 授諭遣之，命千戶尹勝誘執苗金蟲，斬以徇。

translations.literal: Shou instructed them to depart, ordered the company commander Yin Sheng to lure and seize Miao Jin-chong, and beheaded him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Shou dismissed the surrendered tribes, had Company Commander Yin Sheng lure Jin-chong into capture, and executed him as an example.

sentences.zh: 景泰五年，巡撫王永壽以苗賊蒙能攻圍龍裏、新化、銅鼓諸城，乞調兵剿之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jingtai the grand coordinator Wang Yong-shou memorialized that the Miao bandit Meng Neng was attacking and besieging Longli, Xinhua, Tonggu, and other cities, and begged that troops be mobilized to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1454 Grand Coordinator Wang Yong-shou reported that the Miao rebel Meng Neng was besieging Longli, Xinhua, Tonggu, and other towns and requested troops.

sentences.zh: 時賊欲取龍裏為巢穴，攻破亮寨、銅鼓、羅圍堡諸城，都指揮汪迪為賊所殺。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits wished to take Longli as their lair; they broke through Liangzhai, Tonggu, and Luowei-bao and other cities; the provincial commander Wang Di was killed by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels aimed to make Longli their base, overran Liangzhai, Tonggu, and Luowei-bao, and killed Provincial Commander Wang Di.

sentences.zh: 朝議以南和伯方瑛為平蠻將軍，統湖廣諸軍討之。

translations.literal: The court deliberated and appointed the Marquis of Nanhe Fang Ying as Pacification General for the Barbarians, commanding Huguang troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Marquis Fang Ying of Nanhe Pacification General and sent Huguang forces against them.

sentences.zh: 蒙能糾賊眾三萬出攻平溪衛，瑛遣指揮鄭泰等以火槍攻，斃賊三千人，能亦死。

translations.literal: Meng Neng gathered thirty thousand bandit followers to attack Pingxi Guard; Ying dispatched the commander Zheng Tai and others to attack with fire-lances; three thousand bandits were killed and Neng also died.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Neng led 30,000 rebels against Pingxi Guard; Fang Ying's commander Zheng Tai routed them with firearms, killing 3,000 rebels and Neng himself.

sentences.zh: 而能黨李珍等尚煽惑苗眾，官軍計擒之，克復銅鼓、藕洞，連破鬼板等一百六十余寨，覃洞、上隆諸苗悉降。

translations.literal: Yet Neng's partisans Li Zhen and others still incited the Miao masses; government troops by stratagem captured them, recovered Tonggu and Ou-dong, and in succession broke Guiban and more than one hundred sixty stockades; the Miao of Tan-dong, Shang-long, and others all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Neng's lieutenants Li Zhen and others still stirred the tribes, but government troops captured them by stratagem, retook Tonggu and Ou-dong, stormed over 160 stockades including Guiban, and brought Tan-dong, Shang-long, and the rest to submission.

sentences.zh: 天順元年，鎮守太監阮讓言：「東苗為貴州諸苗之首，負固據險，僭號稱王，逼脅他種，東苗平則諸苗服。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun the garrison eunuch Ruan Rang said: "The Eastern Miao are the head of all Miao in Guizhou; they cling to rugged terrain, usurp titles and call themselves kings, and coerce other tribes; when the Eastern Miao are pacified the other Miao will submit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1457 Garrison Eunuch Ruan Rang reported that the Eastern Miao led Guizhou's tribes, held the high ground, styled themselves kings, and intimidated neighbors, and that subduing them would bring the rest to heel.

sentences.zh: 臣會同方瑛計議，並請師期。

translations.literal: Your subject met with Fang Ying to plan and also requested a date for combined operations.
translations.idiomatic: He conferred with Fang Ying on strategy and asked the court to set a campaign schedule.

sentences.zh: 」於是頒諭四川、湖廣諸宣慰、宣撫會師討賊。

translations.literal: " Thereupon orders were issued to the pacification commissioners and superintendents of Sichuan and Huguang to unite their forces and punish the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered the Sichuan and Huguang pacification offices to muster joint forces against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 三年，督理軍務都御史白圭以谷種山箐，乃東苗羽翼，宜先剿。

translations.literal: In the third year the supervising censor-in-chief for military affairs Bai Gui said that Guchong Mountain stockade was a wing of the Eastern Miao and should be suppressed first.
translations.idiomatic: In 1459 Military Affairs Commissioner Bai Gui argued that Guchong Mountain, a Eastern Miao stronghold, should be struck first.

sentences.zh: 因同瑛進青崖，令總兵李貴進牛皮箐，參將劉玉進谷種，參將李震進鬼山。

translations.literal: Accordingly, together with Ying he advanced on Qingya, ordered the supreme commander Li Gui to enter Niupi stockade, Assistant Commander Liu Yu to enter Guchong, and Assistant Commander Li Zhen to enter Guishan.
translations.idiomatic: With Fang Ying he moved on Qingya while Li Gui took Niupi stockade, Liu Yu Guchong, and Li Zhen Guishan.

sentences.zh: 所向皆捷，克水車壩等一百十七寨。

translations.literal: Wherever they went they prevailed, taking Shuicheba and one hundred seventeen stockades.
translations.idiomatic: They won every engagement, capturing 117 stockades including Shuicheba.

sentences.zh: 諸將復合兵青崖，攻石門山，克擺傷等三十九寨。

translations.literal: The generals again combined at Qingya, attacked Shimenshan, and took Baishang and thirty-eight other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Reuniting at Qingya they stormed Shimen Mountain and seized 39 stockades including Baishang.

sentences.zh: 仍分兵四路，進攻董農、竹蓋、甲底等四百三十七寨。

translations.literal: They still divided forces into four routes and advanced against Dongnong, Zhugai, Jidi, and four hundred thirty-seven other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Four columns then pressed Dongnong, Zhugai, Jidi, and 437 more stockades.

sentences.zh: 賊首幹把豬退守六美山。

translations.literal: The bandit leader Ganba-zhu retreated to defend Liumei Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel chief Ganba-zhu fell back to Liumei Mountain.

sentences.zh: 合兵大進，斬五千余級，生擒幹把豬，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: United forces advanced in strength, beheaded more than five thousand, captured Ganba-zhu alive, and sent him to the capital for execution.
translations.idiomatic: A general assault followed; over 5,000 were beheaded, Ganba-zhu was taken alive and executed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是，麻城人李添保以逋賦逃入苗中，詭稱唐後，聚眾萬余，僭稱王，建元武烈。

translations.literal: Earlier, Li Tianbao of Macheng, having fled tax arrears into the Miao, falsely claimed descent from the Tang, gathered more than ten thousand men, usurped the title of king, and adopted the reign title Wulie.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Tianbao of Macheng, a tax fugitive among the Miao who claimed Tang imperial descent, had raised 10,000 men, proclaimed himself king, and declared the era name Wulie.

sentences.zh: 署故賊首蒙能子聰為總兵官，遺之銀印敕書，縱兵剽掠，震動遠近。

translations.literal: He appointed the former bandit Meng Neng's son Cong as supreme commander, gave him a silver seal and patent, and let his troops plunder, shaking the region far and near.
translations.idiomatic: He named Meng Neng's son Cong supreme commander, issued him a silver seal and commission, and unleashed raids that terrified the countryside.

sentences.zh: 至是為李震所敗，余賊大潰。

translations.literal: At this time he was defeated by Li Zhen; the remaining bandits collapsed in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhen now routed him and the remnant rebels scattered.

sentences.zh: 添保僅以身免，潛入鬼池及絞洞諸寨，復煽諸苗劫攻中林、龍裏，亦為震擒，伏誅。

translations.literal: Tianbao barely escaped with his life, slipped into Guichi and Jiaodong stockades, again incited the Miao to raid Zhonglin and Longli, and was also captured by Zhen and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao alone escaped, hid among Guichi and Jiaodong stockades, stirred new attacks on Zhonglin and Longli, and was finally captured and executed by Zhen.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十八年，皮林逆苗吳國佐、石纂太等作亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Wanli the rebellious Miao of Pilin, Wu Guozuo and Shi Zuantai, among others, rose in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: In 1600 Pilin rebels Wu Guozuo and Shi Zuantai and others rebelled.

sentences.zh: 國佐本洪州司特洞寨苗，頗知書，嘗入永從學為生員，素桀黠，皮林諸苗推服之。

translations.literal: Guozuo was originally a Miao of Tedong stockade in Hongzhou Subprefecture, knew books somewhat, had once studied at Yongcong and become a licentiate, was by nature fierce and cunning, and the Miao of Pilin looked up to him.
translations.idiomatic: Guozuo, a literate Tedong stockade Miao who had studied at Yongcong and become a licentiate, was cunning and commanded Pilin's respect.

sentences.zh: 因娶叛人吳大榮妾，為黎平府所持，遂反。

translations.literal: Because he took the concubine of the defector Wu Darong and was prosecuted by Liping Prefecture, he therefore rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: After marrying defector Wu Darong's concubine drew prosecution from Liping Prefecture, he turned rebel.

sentences.zh: 自稱天皇上將，陽聽撫而陰與播賊通。

translations.literal: He styled himself Heavenly Emperor Great General, outwardly accepted pacification while secretly communicating with the Bozhou rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He called himself Heavenly Emperor Great General, feigned submission, and colluded with Bozhou rebels.

sentences.zh: 纂太亦自稱太保，殺百戶黃鐘等百余人，與國佐合兵圍上黃堡。

translations.literal: Zuantai also styled himself Grand Mentor, killed more than one hundred persons including Centurion Huang Zhong, and joined Guozuo in besieging Shanghuang Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Zuantai styled himself Grand Mentor, slaughtered over 100 people including Centurion Huang Zhong, and allied with Guozuo to besiege Shanghuang Fort.

sentences.zh: 參將黃沖霄討之，敗績。

translations.literal: Assistant Commander Huang Chongxiao campaigned against them and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Commander Huang Chongxiao attacked them and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 殺守備張世忠，焚五開，破永從縣，圍中潮所。

translations.literal: They killed Garrison Commander Zhang Shizhong, burned Wukai, broke Yongcong County, and besieged Zhongchao garrison.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Garrison Commander Zhang Shizhong, burned Wukai, overran Yongcong County, and encircled Zhongchao garrison.

sentences.zh: 總兵陳良比、陳璘合湖、貴兵進討，亦失利，國佐益橫。

translations.literal: Supreme commanders Chen Liangbi and Chen Lin combined Huguang and Guizhou troops to advance and punish them, also met defeat, and Guozuo grew more arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme commanders Chen Liangbi and Chen Lin led joint Huguang-Guizhou forces but lost again, and Guozuo grew bolder.

sentences.zh: 二十九年命巡撫江鐸會兵分七路進剿，苗據險不出。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he ordered Grand Coordinator Jiang Duo to unite forces and advance by seven routes to suppress them; the Miao held the passes and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: In 1601 Grand Coordinator Jiang Duo was ordered to attack along seven routes; the Miao held the heights and refused battle.

sentences.zh: 陳璘潛師奪隘，縱火焚其巢。

translations.literal: Chen Lin secretly moved troops to seize the pass, set fires, and burned their nests.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Lin stole a march, seized the defile, and burned their strongholds.

sentences.zh: 國佐逃，擒之，纂太亦為他將誘縛，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Guozuo fled, was captured, and Zuantai was also lured and bound by another general; both were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guozuo fled but was taken; Zuatai was tricked and bound by another commander; both were put to death.

sentences.zh: 安順，普裏部蠻所居。

translations.literal: Anshun was where the Pulibu barbarians dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: Anshun was the homeland of the Pulibu tribes.

sentences.zh: 元世祖置普定府，成宗時改普定路，又為普安路，並屬雲南。

translations.literal: The Yuan founder established Puding Prefecture; under Emperor Chengzong it became Puding Circuit, then Pu'an Circuit, all subordinate to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan first set up Puding Prefecture, later Puding and then Pu'an circuits, both under Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 洪武初為普定府，十六年改為安順州，隸四川。

translations.literal: In the beginning of Hongwu it was Puding Prefecture; in the sixteenth year it was changed to Anshun Prefecture and placed under Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu it was Puding Prefecture; in 1383 it became Anshun subprefecture under Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 正統三年改屬貴州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong it was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1438 jurisdiction passed to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中改安順軍民府，以普安等州屬焉。

translations.literal: In the Wanli period it was changed to the Anshun army-and-civilian prefecture, with Pu'an and other subprefectures subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wanli it became the Anshun army-civilian prefecture, absorbing Pu'an and other districts.

sentences.zh: 普安，故軍民府也，初隸雲南，尋廢為衛。

translations.literal: Pu'an was formerly an army-and-civilian prefecture, at first under Yunnan, soon abolished and made a guard.
translations.idiomatic: Pu'an, once an army-civilian prefecture under Yunnan, was soon abolished and converted to a guard.

sentences.zh: 永樂間改為州，始隸貴州，領長官司二：曰寧谷，曰西堡。

translations.literal: In the Yongle period it was changed to a subprefecture, first placed under Guizhou, and oversaw two native chieftaincies: Ninggu and Xibao.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongle it became a subprefecture under Guizhou with two native offices: Ninggu and Xibao.

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，普定府女總管適爾及其弟阿甕來朝，遂命適爾為知府，許世襲。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu the female chief steward of Puding Prefecture Shi'er and her younger brother A-weng came to court; Shi'er was appointed prefect and granted hereditary tenure.
translations.idiomatic: In 1372 Puding's female administrator Shi'er and her brother A-weng presented themselves; she was confirmed as prefect with hereditary tenure.

sentences.zh: 六年設普定府流官二員。

translations.literal: In the sixth year two regular officials were established for Puding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1373 two circulating officials were posted to Puding.

sentences.zh: 十四年城普定。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Puding was walled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1381 the Puding city walls were built.

sentences.zh: 十五年，普定軍民知府者額來朝，賜米及衣鈔，命諭其部眾，有子弟皆令入國學。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhe'e, army-and-civilian prefect of Puding, came to court; he was given rice and robes with cash, ordered to instruct his tribesmen, and all with sons were to enter the National University.
translations.idiomatic: In 1382 Puding's army-civilian prefect Zhe'e came to court, received grain and gifts, and was told to send promising youths to the National University.

sentences.zh: 十六年，者額遣弟阿昌及八十一砦長阿窩等來朝。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Zhe'e sent his younger brother Achang and stockade head A-wo of eighty-one stockades to court.
translations.idiomatic: In 1383 Zhe'e sent his brother Achang and A-wo, headman of 81 stockades, to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十年詔征普定、安順等州六長官赴京，命以銀二十萬備糴，遣普定侯陳桓等率諸軍駐普安屯田，明年，越州叛苗阿資率眾寇普安，燒府治，大肆剽掠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he ordered the six chieftains of Puding, Anshun, and other subprefectures to proceed to the capital, granted two hundred thousand taels of silver for grain purchase, and dispatched Marquis of Puding Chen Huan and others to lead troops garrisoned at Pu'an for colony fields; the next year the rebellious Miao A-zi of Yuezhou led masses to raid Pu'an, burned the prefectural seat, and plundered on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: In 1387 six native chiefs of Puding and Anshun were summoned to court; 200,000 taels were allotted for grain and Chen Huan's troops were stationed at Pu'an for military colonies; the next year Yuezhou rebel A-zi sacked Pu'an and burned the yamen.

sentences.zh: 征南將軍傅友德擊走之，旦詣軍門降，遂改軍民府為指揮使司。

translations.literal: The southern expedition general Fu Youde drove him off; at dawn he came to the army gate to surrender, and the army-and-civilian prefecture was then changed to a commander's office.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Youde repulsed him; A-zi surrendered at dawn, and the prefecture was converted to a commander's office.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，西平侯沐英奏普安百夫長密即叛，殺屯田官軍及驛丞試百戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying memorialized that the Pu'an centurion Mi-ji had rebelled and killed colony troops and the postal station assistant centurion.
translations.idiomatic: In 1390 Mu Ying reported that Pu'an centurion Mi-ji had rebelled and murdered colony troops and postal officials.

sentences.zh: 調指揮張泰討之於盤江木窄關，官軍失利。

translations.literal: Commander Zhang Tai was transferred to punish him at Panjiang Muzhai Pass; government troops met defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhang Tai was sent to Panjiang Muzhai Pass but was beaten.

sentences.zh: 更調指揮蔣文統烏撒、畢節、永寧三衛軍剿之，乃遁。

translations.literal: Commander Jiang Wen was transferred instead with troops of Wusa, Bijie, and Yongning guards to suppress them, and they fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wen then led Wusa, Bijie, and Yongning troops against them and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，普定西堡長官司阿德及諸寨長作亂，命貴州都指揮顧成討平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Ade of the Xibao native chieftaincy and stockade heads rebelled; Guizhou regional commander Gu Cheng was ordered to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1393 Ade of Xibao and allied stockade chiefs rebelled; Regional Commander Gu Cheng suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，成討平西堡土官阿傍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Cheng suppressed the Xibao native official A-bang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1395 Cheng defeated Xibao native officer A-bang.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，西堡滄浪寨長必莫者聚眾亂，阿革傍等亦糾三千余人助惡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Bimo-zhe of Canglang stockade in Xibao gathered masses in disorder, and A-ge-bang and others also mustered more than three thousand to aid the evil.
translations.idiomatic: In 1398 Bimo-zhe of Xibao's Canglang stockade rose up, joined by A-ge-bang with 3,000 men.

sentences.zh: 成皆擊斬之，其地悉平。

translations.literal: Cheng attacked and beheaded them all; the territory was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng attacked, beheaded the ringleaders, and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，故普安安撫者昌之子慈長言：「建文時父任是職，宜襲，吏部罷之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle Zhechang's son Cichang of the former Pu'an pacification superintendent said: "In the Jianwen period my father held this post and ought to inherit it; the Ministry of Personnel abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1403 Cichang, son of former Pu'an Pacification Superintendent Zhechang, argued that his father's Jianwen-era post should pass to him but the Ministry of Personnel had abolished it.

sentences.zh: 本境地闊民稠，輸糧三千余石，乞仍前職報效。

translations.literal: Our territory is broad and the people numerous; we deliver more than three thousand piculs of grain; I beg restoration of the former office to repay service.
translations.idiomatic: He noted the district's size and 3,000-plus piculs of grain tribute and asked for the old pacification post back.

sentences.zh: 」命仍予安撫。

translations.literal: " He was ordered to receive the pacification post again.
translations.idiomatic: The court restored him as pacification superintendent.

sentences.zh: 十三年改普安安撫司為普安州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Pu'an Pacification Superintendent's office was changed to Pu'an Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1415 the Pu'an pacification office became Pu'an Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年，慈長謀占營長地，且強娶民人妻為妾，殺其夫，閹其子。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Cichang plotted to seize camp-head land and forcibly took a commoner's wife as concubine, killed her husband, and castrated her son.
translations.idiomatic: In 1416 Cichang seized camp lands, abducted a man's wife, murdered the husband, and castrated the son.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命布政司孟驥按狀。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported he ordered Provincial Administration Commissioner Meng Ji to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Provincial Commissioner Meng Ji to investigate.

sentences.zh: 慈長糾兵萬余圍驥，驥以計擒之，逮至京，死於獄。

translations.literal: Cichang mustered more than ten thousand troops and besieged Ji; Ji captured him by stratagem, escorted him to the capital, and he died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Cichang raised 10,000 men to besiege Ji, but Ji seized him by ruse, sent him to the capital, and he died in jail.

sentences.zh: 天順四年，西堡蠻賊聚眾焚劫，鎮守貴州內官鄭忠、右副總兵李貴請調川雲都司官兵二萬，並貴州宣慰安隴富兵二萬進剿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianshun Western Bao barbarian bandits gathered to burn and plunder; Guizhou garrison eunuch Zheng Zhong and Vice Supreme Commander Li Gui requested more than twenty thousand troops from Sichuan, Yunnan, and regional commands plus twenty thousand from Guizhou Pacification Commissioner An Longfu to advance and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1460 Xibao raiders burned and looted; Eunuch Zheng Zhong and Vice Commander Li Gui asked for 40,000 troops from Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou commands to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 至阿果，擒賊首楚得隆等，斬首二百余級。

translations.literal: Reaching Aguo they captured bandit leaders Chu Delong and others and beheaded more than two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: At Aguo they captured Chu Delong and other chiefs and took 200 heads.

sentences.zh: 余賊奔白石崖，復斬級七百余，焚其巢而還。

translations.literal: The remaining bandits fled to Baishiya; another seven hundred-odd were beheaded, their nests burned, and the troops returned.
translations.idiomatic: Survivors fled to Baishiya; 700 more were killed, their camps burned, and the column withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十年，安順土知州張承祖與所屬寧谷寨長官顧鐘爭地仇殺。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Anshun native subprefect Zhang Chengzu and Ninggu stockade chieftain Gu Zhong feuded over land and killed each other.
translations.idiomatic: In 1466 Anshun native subprefect Zhang Chengzu and Ninggu chieftain Gu Zhong fought a land feud to the death.

sentences.zh: 下巡撫究治，命各貢馬贖罪。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator was ordered to investigate; each was commanded to present horses in atonement.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator was sent to adjudicate; both were ordered to offer horses as penalty.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年，貴州總兵吳經奏，西堡獅子孔洞等苗作亂，先調雲南軍八千助防守。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Chenghua Guizhou supreme commander Wu Jing memorialized that Miao of Shizikong Cave in Xibao had rebelled; Yunnan troops eight thousand were first transferred to aid defense.
translations.idiomatic: In 1478 Supreme Commander Wu Jing reported Xibao's Shizikong Cave Miao in revolt and first shifted 8,000 Yunnan troops to garrison the area.

sentences.zh: 聞雲南有警，乞改調沅州、清浪諸軍應援。

translations.literal: Hearing Yunnan had alarms, he begged to transfer Yuanzhou and Qinglang troops instead for support.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan itself was threatened, he asked to replace them with Yuanzhou and Qinglang troops.

sentences.zh: 十五年，經奏已擒斬賊首阿屯、堅婁等，以捷聞。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Jing memorialized that bandit leaders A-tun and Jian-lou had been captured and beheaded, reporting the victory.
translations.idiomatic: In 1479 Jing reported the capture and execution of rebel chiefs A-tun and Jian-lou.

sentences.zh: 弘治十一年，普安州土判官隆暢妻米魯反。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Hongzhi the native judge of Pu'an Subprefecture Long Chang's wife Milu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1498 Milu, wife of Pu'an native judge Long Chang, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 米魯者，沾益州土知州安民女也，適暢被出，居其父家。

translations.literal: Milu was the daughter of Zhanyi native subprefect An Min; having been divorced by Chang she lived at her father's house.
translations.idiomatic: Milu, daughter of Zhanyi subprefect An Min, had been divorced by Chang and lived with her father.

sentences.zh: 暢老，前妻子禮襲，父子不相能。

translations.literal: Chang was old; his son by a former wife, Li, inherited; father and son were incompatible.
translations.idiomatic: The aging Chang's son Li by a prior wife succeeded him, and father and son were at odds.

sentences.zh: 米魯與營長阿保通，因令阿保諷禮迎己，禮與阿保同烝之。

translations.literal: Milu communicated with camp head A-bao, who therefore urged Li to welcome her; Li and A-bao both took her in levirate union.
translations.idiomatic: Milu conspired with camp chief A-bao, who persuaded Li to take her back; Li and A-bao both cohabited with her.

sentences.zh: 暢聞怒，立殺禮，毀阿保寨。

translations.literal: When Chang heard he was furious, immediately killed Li, and destroyed A-bao's stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Chang, enraged, killed Li and razed A-bao's stockade.

sentences.zh: 阿保挾魯與其子阿鲊等攻暢，暢走雲南。

translations.literal: A-bao carried Milu and his son A-zha and others to attack Chang; Chang fled to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: A-bao, Milu, and son A-zha attacked; Chang fled to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 時東寧伯焦俊為總兵官，與巡撫錢鉞和解之。

translations.literal: At the time the Earl of Dongning Jiao Jun was supreme commander; together with Grand Coordinator Qian Yue he reconciled them.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Commander Earl Jiao Jun and Grand Coordinator Qian Yue brokered a truce.

sentences.zh: 魯於道中毒暢死，遂與保據寨反。

translations.literal: Milu poisoned Chang to death on the road, then with Bao seized stockades and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Milu poisoned Chang en route, then with Bao seized stockades and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 暢妾曰適烏，生二子，別居南安。

translations.literal: Chang's concubine was called Shi-wu; she bore two sons and lived separately at Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Chang's concubine Shi-wu, mother of two sons, lived apart at Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 米魯欲並殺之，築寨圍其城。

translations.literal: Milu wished also to kill them and built stockades to besiege their city.
translations.idiomatic: Milu sought to kill them too and walled stockades around Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 又別築三寨於普安，而令阿鲊等防守。

translations.literal: She also built three stockades at Pu'an and ordered A-zha and others to defend them.
translations.idiomatic: She fortified three camps at Pu'an under A-zha's guard.

sentences.zh: 名所居寨曰承天，自號無敵天王，出入建黃纛，官兵不能制，鎮巡以聞。

translations.literal: She named her dwelling stockade Chengtian, styled herself Invincible Heavenly King, went out and in under yellow banners, and government troops could not control her; the garrison and touring officials reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Her headquarters she called Chengtian; she styled herself Invincible Heavenly King, marched under yellow banners, defied government troops, and officials reported the crisis.

sentences.zh: 發十衛及諸土兵萬三千人分道進，責安民殺賊自贖。

translations.literal: Ten guards and more than thirteen thousand native troops were dispatched by separate routes, charging An Min to kill the bandits to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Ten guards and 13,000 native troops moved on separate routes, ordering An Min to redeem himself by destroying the rebels.

sentences.zh: 民乃攻斬阿保父子於查剌寨，米魯亡走。

translations.literal: Min then attacked and beheaded A-bao and his son at Chala stockade; Milu fled.
translations.idiomatic: An Min stormed Chala, killed A-bao and his son, and Milu fled.

sentences.zh: 焦俊等責安民獻魯，民陰資魯兵五百襲殺適烏及其二子，據別寨殺掠，又自請襲為女土官。

translations.literal: Jiao Jun and others charged An Min to deliver Milu; Min secretly supplied Milu five hundred troops who raided and killed Shi-wu and her two sons, seized another stockade to kill and plunder, and himself asked to succeed as female native official.
translations.idiomatic: Jun demanded Milu from An Min, but Min secretly gave her 500 men who murdered Shi-wu and her sons, raided anew, and sought the female chieftaincy for himself.

sentences.zh: 鎮巡官皆受魯賂，請宥魯。

translations.literal: The garrison and touring officials all accepted bribes from Milu and requested pardon for her.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials took Milu's bribes and pleaded for her pardon.

sentences.zh: 嚴旨切責，必得魯乃已。

translations.literal: Stern edicts sharply rebuked them; only when Milu was obtained would it stop.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial reprimands insisted that Milu be captured before the case could close.

sentences.zh: 貴州副使劉福陰索賂於魯，故緩師。

translations.literal: Guizhou Vice Commissioner Liu Fu secretly extorted bribes from Milu and therefore delayed the army.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Liu Fu took Milu's bribes and deliberately slowed the campaign.

sentences.zh: 賊益熾，官兵敗於阿馬坡，都指揮吳遠被擄，普安幾陷。

translations.literal: The bandits grew fiercer; government troops were defeated at Amapo; Regional Commander Wu Yuan was captured; Pu'an nearly fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels surged; troops lost at Amapo; Commander Wu Yuan was taken; Pu'an nearly fell.

sentences.zh: 帝命南京戶部尚書王軾、巡撫陳金、都指揮李政進剿，破二十余寨。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Nanjing Minister of Revenue Wang Shi, Grand Coordinator Chen Jin, and Regional Commander Li Zheng to advance and suppress them, breaking more than twenty stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Wang Shi, Grand Coordinator Chen Jin, and Commander Li Zheng, who stormed 20-odd stockades.

sentences.zh: 魯竄馬尾籠，官兵圍之，就擒，伏誅。

translations.literal: Milu hid at Maweilong; government troops surrounded and captured her; she was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Milu hid at Maweilong, was surrounded and captured, and executed.

sentences.zh: 安民自辨，得赦。

translations.literal: An Min excused himself and received pardon.
translations.idiomatic: An Min cleared himself and was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 正德元年，暢族婦適擦襲土判官，赴京朝貢，帝嘉之。
